request.style: English, advent orchestral folk, gentle female vocal with male choir in the chorus, strings, oboe, acoustic guitar, harp, timpani swells, expectant and tender, 74 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The candles in the window, the winter on the hill
A people long in exile, and waiting, waiting still
Then over the dark water there came a gentle word
The kindest voice of heaven that ever earth had heard

[Chorus]
Comfort, comfort my people, says your God
Speak tenderly to Jerusalem
In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD
Make straight in the desert a highway for our God

[Verse]
Every valley shall be lifted up
Every mountain and hill made low
And the glory of the LORD will be revealed
And all flesh together will see it

[Chorus]
Comfort, comfort my people, says your God
Speak tenderly to Jerusalem
In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD
Make straight in the desert a highway for our God

[Bridge]
The grass withers, the flower fades
But the word of our God stands forever
He tends his flock like a shepherd
He gathers the lambs in his arms
And carries them close to his heart

[Outro]
Here is your God
Here is your God
